gloss: to request, to ask a favor

definitions.gloss: to request, to ask (someone to do something)
definitions.explanation: To politely ask someone to do something or to make a request.

definitions.gloss: to pray for, to wish for
definitions.explanation: To pray or make a wish, often at a shrine or temple.

examples.japanese: お{願|ねが}いがあるんですが。
examples.english: I have a favor to ask.
examples.notes: Common way to introduce a request

examples.japanese: コーヒーをお{願|ねが}いします。
{神社|じんじゃ}で{合格|ごうかく}をお{願|ねが}いした。
examples.english: I prayed for success at the shrine.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{願|ねが}いします: Please (very common polite request)
- よろしくお{願|ねが}いします: I look forward to working with you / Please take care of this

USAGE:
お{願|ねが}いする is the polite form of {頼|たの}む. It is widely used in polite speech for making requests of any kind.
